WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A movie or TV series saved by an authenticated user to their Watched or Want to Watch list for permanent cloud backup and offline viewing.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this watchlist entry.

mediaId.description: Unique identifier of the movie or TV series.

title.description: Display title of the movie or series.

mediaType.description: Whether the entry is a movie or a TV series.

status.description: Watchlist status selected by the user.

releaseStatus.description: Whether the title is already released or upcoming.

overview.description: Plot summary of the movie or series.

trailerUrl.description: Direct MP4 or YouTube embed trailer URL.

fullMovieUrl.description: Direct stream URL for full movie playback when available.

castSummary.description: Serialized cast summary for offline viewing.

userNotes.description: Optional personal review or notes by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last updated (must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{mediaId}.description: Per-user cloud-synced Watched and Want to Watch movie/series entries.
